title: 正文 第十二章  湖边聚会
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

树上的海棠花凋谢，纷纷落下，与地上莫名野花交相争艳。幻天伸手轻捻一片海棠花瓣，海棠无香，唯以妖艳动人。

旁边泉水叮咚，竹影西斜，成双对的鸟儿遇人不惊，落在海棠树梢上，歪着脑袋好奇的看着幻天。

徐辉几人去寻找各自的好友，打算乘这个机会举办一个宴会，交流一翻，能来到此地的都是各派精英，现在混个脸熟，对于以后的的成长百利而无一害。石心月也去找王语兰了，她好像很喜欢这个温柔的姐姐。而寻找场地这个任务就交给了幻天。

看着烟波浩渺的湖面，幻天将手里的海棠花瓣丢向了空中，两只彩蝶追寻，随着花瓣一起飞舞。

“就这里了。”幻天盘膝而作，等待着众人集合。多日的生死厮杀，让人有些疲劳。感触着身边纷飞的花雨，嗅着弥漫水汽的花香，幻天陷入了难得的空灵之境。

刚刚陷入空灵之境，幻天鼻尖传来一阵清香。闻着熟悉的味道，幻天睁开了眼睛说道：“你来干吗？不是找你的语兰姐姐去了吗。”

“幻天，你难道没看出我与之前有什么不同吗？”石心月突然贴近幻天说道。

“没什么不同啊！”幻天仔细看了石心月几眼说道。

“哎呀！你再仔细看看。”石心月皱起了秀眉说道。

“你到底要干什么？刚进入的空灵之境就被你弄醒了。”幻天突然说到。

“你就知道修炼，没看见我的衣服和发型都换了吗。你怎么这么讨厌。”石心月生气。

“无理取闹。”幻天懒得理她。

“幻天……你……你就是个笨蛋。”石心月说完就跑开了。

“月儿……”幻天呼叫，怕她生气之后再惹出什么乱子。可下一刻他就被眼前的天象给迷住了。而石心月也停下了脚步，好奇的看着周围。

天，突然变得黑了，没有一丝光芒。

各种白天不起眼的植物抽出了嫩芽，闪耀着迷蒙光芒，草木霞光，萤蝶飞舞。

啵！啵！啵！

周围的几颗千年古木流光盘旋，上方盛开了一朵朵桌子大小的花朵，粉色的光芒至上方传来。

苍茫古劲的森林之中各种亮光闪烁，如同一片星河坠落其中，美轮美奂。

“漂亮吧！”听见声音，幻天回首。看见以徐辉、苍岚为首来了七八个人。

“确实难得一见，不过最让我好奇的是此地的天象。白天与黑夜的交替为何如此的迅捷。”幻天好奇。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The begonia flowers on the trees withered and fell one after another, competing with the inexplicable wild flowers on the ground.Huantian reached out and gently twisted a piece of crabapple petals. The crabapple has no fragrance, but is charming and charming.

The spring water nearby was tinkling, the bamboo shadows were slanting to the west, and pairs of birds were not surprised when they met people. They landed on the tops of the crabapple trees and tilted their heads to look at Huantian curiously.

Xu Hui and others went to look for their friends, planning to take this opportunity to hold a banquet. After some exchanges, they found that the people who came here were elites from various factions. Now that they were familiar with each other, it would be of great benefit to their future growth.Shi Xinyue also went to see Wang Yulan. She seemed to like this gentle sister very much.The task of finding the venue was left to Huantian.

Looking at the vast misty lake, Huantian threw the begonia petals in his hand into the air. Two colorful butterflies followed and flew with the petals.

"It's here." Huantian sat cross-legged, waiting for everyone to gather.Many days of life and death fighting made people a little tired.Feeling the rain of flowers flying around him and smelling the fragrance of flowers filled with water vapor, Huantian fell into a rare ethereal state.

Just as he fell into an ethereal state, a burst of fragrance came from the tip of Huantian's nose.Smelling the familiar smell, Huantian opened his eyes and said, "What are you doing here? Aren't you looking for your sister Yulan?"

"Huantian, don't you see any difference between me and before?" Shi Xinyue suddenly approached Huantian and said.

"There's no difference!" Huantian looked at Shi Xinyue carefully and said.

"Oops! Take a closer look." Shi Xinyue frowned and said.

"What on earth are you going to do? You woke me up just after entering the ethereal realm." Huantian said suddenly.

"You know how to practice. Didn't you see that my clothes and hairstyle have changed? Why are you so annoying?" Shi Xinyue was angry.

"It's unreasonable." Huantian didn't bother to pay attention to her.

"Huantian... you... you are just a fool." Shi Xinyue ran away after saying that.

"Yue'er..." Huantian called, fearing that she would cause any trouble if she got angry.But the next moment he was fascinated by the celestial phenomena in front of him.Shi Xinyue also stopped and looked around curiously.

The sky suddenly became dark without any light.

Various plants that are inconspicuous during the day have sprouted buds, shining with misty light, the grass and trees are glowing, and fireflies are flying.

Bo!Bo!Bo!

Several thousand-year-old trees were surrounded by light, and table-sized flowers bloomed above. Pink light came from above.

All kinds of bright lights flicker in the vast and ancient forest, like a galaxy falling into it, which is magnificent and beautiful.

"Beautiful!" Hearing the voice, Huantian looked back.I saw seven or eight people coming, led by Xu Hui and Cang Lan.

"It is indeed rare to see it, but what makes me most curious is the celestial phenomenon here. Why does the alternation between day and night happen so quickly." Huantian was curious.
